Replace marketing agencies with AI

Uplane replaces marketing agencies with AI. We generate hundreds of ads with matching landing pages and steer the ad spend across channels like Meta, Google, LinkedIn and others. By connecting to CRM and ERP data, Uplane learns what drives profits and continuously improves campaigns.

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by replacing a patchwork of agencies, spreadsheets, and siloed tools with one self-improving system. The result: Higher ROAS for enterprises and effortless, expert-level marketing for SMBs.
Managed 7-digit monthly ad spend as a Marketing Director of one of the fastest-growing D2C brands in Europe. Scaled a lead platform from 0 to >$10M monthly revenue in just 12 weeks.
Has 15 years of fullstack experience, was Head of Engineering at two former YC companies and won Product of the Month at Product Hunt.
Uplane: Replace your marketing agency.
Uplane (YC F25) is building AI software to replace marketing agencies.
Their AI has already created thousands of ads and landing pages, delivering a 20-50% increase in return on ad spend for their customers.

Uplane builds an all-in-one marketing platform that uses AI to create, launch, and test ad campaigns across Meta, Google, Taboola, TikTok, and others. The software delivers new, creative ideas, and gives full flexibility to ensure every marketing message is on brand and compliant.
In marketing, speed and analytics are essential. Humans simply can’t catch up with the speed and precision of AI.
For years, the promise of digital marketing has been data-driven revenue growth at scale. The reality for most marketers, however, is a losing battle fought with manual work.

Marketing teams and their agencies are drowning in a sea of spreadsheets, unreliable data, and siloed ad platforms. They are buried in repetitive tasks: endlessly creating and testing ad variations, designing new landing pages, trying to make sense of the data, and manually shifting budgets across ads and channels. This makes it impossible to move at the speed and precision the market demands.
The result: billions of dollars are lost due to low-performing marketing campaigns. No human can do the manual work that is required to do the job right.
Uplane analyzes the target audience, brand style, ads, competitors' ads, and even real-time market trends. It uses these insights to instantly generate thousands of ads and matching landing pages.

Select your favorite ads, and with a single click, campaigns go live across all channels. Uplane takes over, managing everything 24/7. It monitors performance and shifts budget to the ads and channels that deliver the highest return.

Built-in dashboards give instant transparency. The insights from the data are not just useful for marketers but also for our AI. It continuously tracks ad performance, identifies best value propositions and designs, and gets smarter with every conversion. Thus, it creates better ads with every iteration.
Uplane is working hand-in-hand with ambitious companies that want to scale their marketing profitably, eliminate manual work, and make marketing that their customers love.

19 April, 2026

Uplane has raised $4.5 million in a seed round, planning to replace traditional marketing agencies with AI-powered solutions. The US-based platform is leading a push to enable companies to manage their own digital ad campaigns without needing external agencies.

Uplane lets clients launch and test ad campaigns across multiple platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, and LinkedIn, automatically allocating budgets to the best-performing campaigns. The platform provides tools for producing text, display, and video ads, alongside automated landing page testing and development. Clients can use their own creative assets or generate new designs using AI.

The funding round was led by Play Ventures, with participation from Y Combinator and other funds including 20VC, Rebel Fund, and Multimodal Ventures. Uplane was founded last November by Julius Corvign, Lukas Vollmer, and Marvin Abdelmessih, all of whom have experience in digital marketing.

The company focuses on businesses spending over $100,000 monthly on digital marketing, offering its services via an annual fee. Early Uplane clients include health and wellness company Aonic, Australian fintech Wagetap, and Deutsche Bahn.

Co-founder Corvign says clients have seen a 30% improvement in return on ad spend within about six weeks, with improvements reaching 60% in some cases such as Aonic. He notes that Deutsche Bahn was able to execute its campaigns more efficiently and quickly compared to what it received from its previous ad agency.
